MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25003882
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01455223
LONGBRIDGE FINANCIAL LLC, is the
Plaintiff, and MARJORIE M.
BEHRENS, ET ALS., are Defendants,
writ of execution for the sale of
mortgaged premises dated
8/8/2024.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of
FEBRUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE,
County of Middlesex and State of
New Jersey
Premises commonly known as: 14
CHASE AVE, TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE, MAILING ADDRESS 14
CHASE AVE, AVENEL, NJ 07001
Tax Lot: 1248, Tax Block: 856.02
Dimensions of Lot (Approximately):
75 X 100
Nearest Cross Street: AVENEL STREE.
The Plaintiff's Good Faith Estimate
is $135,513.60. The upset amount
may be subject to further Orders of
additional sums.
The current occupancy status is
OWNER OCCUPIED.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of ONE HUNDRED EIGHTEEN THOUSAND FORTY EIGHT
DOLLARS AND FIFTY THREE CENTS
($118,048.53) dollars more or less,
plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official bank check at
close of sale and the balance in two
weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Greenspoon Marder LLP
100 W Cypress Creek Road
Trade Centre South Suite 700
Fort Lauderdale, Fl 33309
Attorneys
